original_caption: A black silk blouse with short, puffed sleeves and a high collar. The blouse features delicate lace trim along the cuffs and neckline.
edit_instruction: Remove the puff from the sleeves to create a sleeker look and add a bow tie closure at the neck.
resulting_caption: A black silk blouse with short, straight sleeves and a high collar featuring a bow tie closure. The blouse has delicate lace trim along the cuffs.

original_caption: A light blue denim jacket with long sleeves, two chest pockets, and a button-down front. The jacket is slightly cropped at the waist.
edit_instruction: Remove one sleeve to create an asymmetrical look and add a single patch pocket on the side.
resulting_caption: An asymmetrical light blue denim jacket with one long sleeve, a button-down front, two chest pockets, and a single patch pocket on the side. The jacket is slightly cropped at the waist.

original_caption: A bright red cotton tank top with thin shoulder straps and a straight hemline.
edit_instruction: Add lace trim along the neckline and hem to enhance the feminine look.
resulting_caption: A bright red cotton tank top with thin shoulder straps, a straight hemline, and lace trim along both the neckline and hem.

original_caption: A white linen button-up shirt with long sleeves, a collar, and a curved hem. The shirt has two chest pockets.
edit_instruction: Shorten the sleeves to cap length and add a single front patch pocket.
resulting_caption: A white linen button-up shirt with short, capped sleeves, a collar, and a curved hem. The shirt features a single front patch pocket.

original_caption: A dark green wool cardigan with long sleeves, ribbed cuffs, and a V-neckline.
edit_instruction: Remove the sleeves to create an open-front vest and add two side slits for ease of movement.
resulting_caption: An open-front dark green wool vest with ribbed cuffs and a V-neckline. The vest features two side slits.

original_caption: A pale yellow cotton blouse with short sleeves, a round neckline, and a straight hem.
edit_instruction: Add lace inserts along the shoulders to create shoulder straps and shorten the hemline into a cropped style.
resulting_caption: A pale yellow cotton blouse with thin shoulder straps made from lace inserts, a round neckline, and a cropped hem.

original_caption: A burgundy velvet blazer with long sleeves, two flap pockets, and a single-breasted front closure. The jacket has a notched lapel.
edit_instruction: Remove the lapels to create an open-front style and add a single patch pocket on one side.
resulting_caption: An open-front burgundy velvet blazer with long sleeves, two flap pockets, and a single-breasted front closure. The jacket features a single patch pocket.

original_caption: A light grey cashmere sweater with long sleeves, a crew neckline, and ribbed cuffs.
edit_instruction: Remove the sleeves to create an open-front vest and add two side slits for ease of movement.
resulting_caption: An open-front light grey cashmere vest with ribbed cuffs and a crew neckline. The vest features two side slits.
